ModMetaData.name: Witcher Base
ModMetaData.author: Tristan
ModMetaData.description:
The foundation mod for a modular Witcher content suite. Adds the Witcher trials to RimWorld Biotech.
Research the trials to transform colonists into witchers: - Trial of Grasses: a brutal initiation. Most who attempt it do not survive. Survivors become witcher initiates with hardened bodies and night sight. - Trial of Dreams: a follow-up trial for initiates. Survivors become fully trained witchers with sharper minds and steadier nerves. - Trial of Mountains: the final trial. Take a witcher contract to hunt a beast on a nearby tile and become a master witcher. - Additional Mutagens: a perilous upgrade for existing witchers that pushes their gifts to the extreme.
Grasses, Dreams, and Mutagens are performed from the Health tab. Mountains contracts are taken from a witcher's health tab once researched. After researching the Trial of Grasses, visit friendly settlements by caravan to buy trial-age children.
Survivors unlock witcher signs (Aard, Igni, Quen, Axii, Yrden) as combat abilities tied to their xenotype stage.
Requires Biotech.
